corrections.text: The headline sets Artificial Analysis's 68.1% on AutomationBench-AA against "Meta's 37.8%". The sources do not show the two figures to be the same measure. Meta's table marks 37.8% "Strict pass@1", and Meta's evaluation report defines it as the share of tasks completed in full; Artificial Analysis's article does not name the metric behind 68.1%, and the data in the page source of its model page stores the value under a field named automationBenchPartialScore (a reading made by the Herald, not stated by Artificial Analysis). The comparison is of two published figures, not a like-for-like gap. The /bin/zsh.14 per task in the headline is Artificial Analysis's weighted average cost per Intelligence Index task.

The article says "Meta's footnote cites Intelligence Index v5.0". The footnote under Meta's announcement reads "Artificial Analysis results are from Intelligence Index v5"; it is Meta's evaluation report that names "Intelligence Index v5.0". Artificial Analysis's model page now shows v5.0.1.
